name: Heart On Ice
source:
Cooper was fascinated by the world of figure skating. To his surprise, he was greeted in person by his favorite figure skater Willow following seeing her performance. After spending some time with her, one thing leads to another and he joined her in a competition. What would he do?

[Edited from [url=https://mikamika-drawz.itch.io/heart-on-ice]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
库珀对花样滑冰世界着迷。令他惊讶的是，他最喜欢的花样滑冰运动员威洛在观看她的表演后亲自迎接了她。和她相处了一段时间后，一件事又变成了另一件事，他和她一起参加了一场比赛。他会怎么做？
